record.field: Notice: Impending Expiry of Accumulated Annual Leave - {{ object.name }}
Sent to employee and supervisor when accumulated annual leave is nearing the 2-year expiration deadline.

div.style: font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.6;
div.p: This is a formal notification regarding your accumulated annual leave balance at EthSwitch S.C.

According to EthSwitch Leave Policy, annual leave may be accumulated for a maximum of two budget years. Any leave balance accumulated beyond this limit will expire unless an official Leave Postponement is approved by the HR Department.
Please coordinate with your immediate supervisor () to utilize this leave or submit a Leave Postponement request via the ERP system before the expiration date.

Best regards,
Human Resources Department
EthSwitch S.C.

record.field: Approved: Your Annual Leave Schedule for {{ object.fiscal_year }}
Sent to employee when their annual leave schedule for the fiscal year has been approved.

div.style: font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.6;
div.p: We are pleased to inform you that your Annual Leave Schedule for fiscal year has been approved.

Important: As per company policy, you are expected to follow this schedule for your annual leave utilization. Any changes or reversals must be submitted for supervisor approval within the designated fiscal quarter.

Best regards,
Human Resources Department
EthSwitch S.C.
